# Bank verification number detection

<!-- Generated by node ci/rule-packs/build-detection.mjs --write. -->

Finds an eleven-digit value within 128 scalar values of a BVN or bank-verification label, including labels after the value. Reports the value location at error severity.

Version: `2026.11.0`. Source: `rule-packs/bvn.pack.json`.

The citation register records owner approval in principle; legal review remains pending. A finding requests review and does not establish a legal breach.

| Rule | Severity | Citation |
|---|---|---|
| `pii.bvn` | error | Review protection of bank verification identifiers. Sections 24(1)(c), 24(1)(f), 39 and 65; Article 29(1)-(2). |

## Limits

Literal keywords are ASCII case-insensitive substrings. Nearby labels provide context, not proof of assignment, data flow or an issued BVN. No public check-digit algorithm is assumed. Longer digit runs, repeated/sequential examples, dates, versions, hex and UUID fragments are excluded by the existing engine controls. Unlabelled identifiers and unsafe field handling are separate rules.

## Remediation and exceptions

Remove unnecessary identifiers from source and test data, use generated fixtures, and mask identifiers before logging. If retention is necessary, use the existing justified-exception configuration and review its scope.

## Synthetic examples

Positive and near-miss examples are generated from the documented synthetic values. Their expected files contain locations only.

## Verification

Run `dotnet test tests/Corpus.Tests -c Release --filter FullyQualifiedName~DetectionPackTests` for exact locations and measured synthetic precision/recall.

These are unsigned release-source packs. Tests sign only in memory with the labelled development key. Production signing, embedding and publication are separate release operations; no development signature is shipped.
